verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a GitHub mention of agent skills that help with engineering decisions "such as quantization." That implies Qdrant offers vector quantization, but the pack has no documentation of how to enable it, what memory or storage savings it gives, or what accuracy it costs. Missing for 10: first-party docs on configuring quantization or compression, documented memory and storage reduction figures, a documented accuracy or recall trade-off, independent or hands-on corroboration.
